descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Truck Racing Pro is a high-intensity VR racing experience that puts you in control of powerful, heavy-duty trucks built for speed and domination. Feel the weight, torque, and raw engine power as you compete in adrenaline-fueled races across dynamic tracks designed to test your precision, control, and racing instincts.

Choose from a variety of uniquely styled trucks, each with distinct handling and performance characteristics. Master sharp turns, manage acceleration, and outmaneuver opponents in competitive events that reward skill and strategy. Realistic physics and immersive VR mechanics place you directly in the driver’s seat, delivering a true sense of scale and speed.

Designed for racing enthusiasts and competitive players alike, Truck Racing Pro combines intense gameplay, immersive environments, and powerful machines to create a thrilling truck racing experience unlike any other. Get ready to start your engine, hit the track, and race like a pro.
